description: This file contains TypeScript code for managing Discord interactions within the openclaw plugin SDK, including handling model picker UI, command argument selection, and interaction routing.

classes.name: DiscordCommandArgButton
classes.description: Button class for handling command argument selection interactions.

classes.name: DiscordCommandArgFallbackButton
classes.description: Fallback button for command argument interactions.

classes.name: DiscordModelPickerFallbackButton
classes.description: Fallback button for model picker interactions.

classes.name: DiscordModelPickerFallbackSelect
classes.description: Fallback select menu for model picker interactions.

methods.name: createCommandArgsWithValue
methods.description: Creates command arguments with a specific value.

methods.name: encodeDiscordCommandArgValue
methods.description: Encodes a string for use in Discord command argument custom IDs.

methods.name: decodeDiscordCommandArgValue
methods.description: Decodes a string from Discord command argument custom IDs.

methods.name: buildDiscordCommandArgCustomId
methods.description: Builds a custom ID string for Discord command argument buttons.

methods.name: parseDiscordCommandArgData
methods.description: Parses component data to extract command argument info.

methods.name: resolveDiscordModelPickerCommandContext
methods.description: Determines if a command is related to model picking.

methods.name: resolveCommandArgStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves and trims a command argument value.

methods.name: shouldOpenDiscordModelPickerFromCommand
methods.description: Decides if the model picker UI should open based on command and args.

methods.name: buildDiscordModelPickerCurrentModel
methods.description: Constructs current model string from provider and model.

methods.name: buildDiscordModelPickerAllowedModelRefs
methods.description: Builds a set of allowed model references from loaded data.

methods.name: resolveDiscordModelPickerPreferenceScope
methods.description: Creates scope info for model picker preferences.

methods.name: buildDiscordModelPickerNoticePayload
methods.description: Creates a payload with a notice message.

methods.name: resolveDiscordModelPickerRouteState
methods.description: Resolves the route state for Discord model picker interactions.

methods.name: resolveDiscordModelPickerRoute
methods.description: Resolves the effective route for Discord model picker.

methods.name: resolveDiscordNativeChoiceContext
methods.description: Gets provider and model info from an autocomplete interaction.

methods.name: resolveDiscordModelPickerCurrentModel
methods.description: Determines the current model reference based on session data.

methods.name: replyWithDiscordModelPickerProviders
methods.description: Replies with the list of available model providers.

methods.name: resolveModelPickerSelectionValue
methods.description: Extracts selected value from interaction.

methods.name: buildDiscordModelPickerSelectionCommand
methods.description: Builds a command object for a selected model.

methods.name: listDiscordModelPickerProviderModels
methods.description: Lists models for a given provider.

methods.name: resolveDiscordModelPickerModelIndex
methods.description: Finds index of a model within provider models.

methods.name: resolveDiscordModelPickerModelByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves model name by index within provider models.

methods.name: splitDiscordModelRef
methods.description: Splits a model reference string into provider and model parts.

methods.name: handleDiscordModelPickerInteraction
methods.description: Handles user interactions with the model picker UI.

methods.name: handleDiscordCommandArgInteraction
methods.description: Handles user interactions with command argument selection.

methods.name: buildDiscordCommandArgMenu
methods.description: Builds a menu of choices for command argument selection.

methods.name: createDiscordCommandArgFallbackButton
methods.description: Creates fallback button for command argument.

methods.name: createDiscordModelPickerFallbackButton
methods.description: Creates fallback button for model picker.

methods.name: createDiscordModelPickerFallbackSelect
methods.description: Creates fallback select menu for model picker.
